pois.name: Taj Mahal
pois.address: Dharmapuri, Forest Colony, Tajganj, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282001
pois.description: Immense mausoleum of white marble built in Agra between 1631 and 1648 by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan. UNESCO World Heritage monument.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Best visited at sunrise (6:00 AM) to experience morning golden mist and avoid tourist crowds
✓ Iconic UNESCO World Wonder
✓ 4.9★ reviews
pois.tip: Arrive at the East Gate by 5:45 AM for fastest entry and serene crowd-free photography. Note: Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays for prayers.

provenance.price_source: Archaeological Survey of India Official Entry (₹50 INR domestic)
provenance.opening_hours_source: Sunrise to Sunset Official ASI Schedule

pois.name: Agra Fort
pois.address: Agra Fort, Rakabganj, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282003
pois.description: Historical red sandstone fortress that served as the primary residence of the emperors of the Mughal Dynasty until 1638.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Massive walled imperial palace complex with marble balconies viewing Taj Mahal
✓ UNESCO World Heritage
✓ 4.7★ reviews
pois.tip: Visit the Musamman Burj where Shah Jahan spent his final years gazing across the river toward the Taj Mahal.

provenance.price_source: Archaeological Survey of India Official Entry (₹50 INR domestic)

pois.name: Mehtab Bagh
pois.address: Nagla Devjit, Opposite Taj Mahal, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282006
pois.description: Charbagh complex perfectly aligned with the Taj Mahal on the opposite bank of the Yamuna River, renowned as the premier sunset viewpoint.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Unobstructed reflection of Taj Mahal at sunset across the Yamuna
✓ Peaceful crowd-free riverside gardens
✓ 4.6★ reviews
pois.tip: Arrive around 5:00 PM for magical golden-hour lighting as the white marble facade turns deep rose and amber.

pois.name: Fatehpur Sikri Imperial Complex
pois.address: Fatehpur Sikri, Agra District, Uttar Pradesh 283110
pois.description: Monumental fortified royal city founded in 1571 by Emperor Akbar, housing the 54-meter Buland Darwaza gate and the white marble Tomb of Salim Chishti.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Fascinating preserved Mughal ghost city
✓ Grand architectural synthesis of Hindu and Islamic styles
✓ UNESCO World Heritage
pois.tip: Located 36 km west of Agra; plan a comfortable half-day excursion with private transit or express taxi.

provenance.price_source: Archaeological Survey of India Official Entry (₹50 INR domestic)

pois.name: Tomb of I'timad-ud-Daulah (Baby Taj)
pois.description: Exquisite white marble jewel box mausoleum built by Nur Jahan for her father between 1622 and 1628, featuring the first extensive pietra dura in India.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Hidden gem often bypassed by tour buses
✓ Incredibly intricate semi-precious stone inlay art
✓ Serene garden ambiance
pois.tip: Spend time examining the fine geometric lattice marble screens (jalis) and floral ceiling motifs.

pois.name: Akbar's Tomb (Sikandra)
pois.address: Tomb of Akbar The Great Area, Sikandra, Agra 282007
pois.description: Vast five-tiered red sandstone and white marble mausoleum of Emperor Akbar set within a sprawling 119-acre park inhabited by deer and peacocks.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Quiet expansive historical complex away from city center bustle
✓ Impressive calligraphic south gate with four minarets
pois.tip: Spot graceful blackbuck deer wandering peacefully across the lawns around the perimeter pathways.

pois.name: Kinari Bazaar Heritage Walk
pois.address: Kinari Bazar Rd, Rawatpara, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282003
pois.description: Vibrant medieval marketplace behind the Jama Masjid, famed for traditional Zardozi gold-thread embroidery, leathercraft, and marble inlay artisans.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Authentic local street atmosphere and artisan workshops
✓ Free cultural exploration
✓ 4.5★ reviews
pois.tip: Note: Shops in Kinari Bazaar are largely closed on Sundays. Practice gentle bargaining when purchasing authentic handicrafts.

pois.name: Sadar Bazaar & Chaat Gali
pois.address: Sadar Bazaar, Agra Cantt, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282001
pois.description: Agra's premier pedestrian shopping and dining promenade, home to Chaat Gali, leather stores, and authentic petha confectioners.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Clean pedestrian promenade with renowned local street delicacies
✓ Evening stroll atmosphere
✓ 4.6★ reviews
pois.tip: Sadar Bazaar is closed on Tuesdays. Visit between 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM for fresh street-side chaat and kulfi.

pois.name: Jama Masjid of Agra
pois.address: Subhash Bazar, Kinari Bazar, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282003
pois.description: Graceful 17th-century red sandstone mosque commissioned by Jahanara Begum, daughter of Shah Jahan, facing the Delhi Gate of Agra Fort.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Outstanding example of classical Mughal religious architecture
✓ Free historical entry
✓ 4.4★ reviews
pois.tip: Dress respectfully with shoulders and knees covered; footwear must be removed at the courtyard entrance.

pois.name: Ram Bagh (Aram Bagh)
pois.address: Firozabad Road, Ram Bagh, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282006
pois.description: Oldest Mughal garden in India, originally laid out by Emperor Babur in 1528 as a stepped riverfront retreat with cascading water channels.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Peaceful shaded historic garden
✓ First Mughal garden architecture in India
✓ Low crowd density
pois.tip: Ideal mid-day tranquil retreat away from the crowds of the main monuments.

pois.name: Chini Ka Rauza
pois.address: Katra Wazir Khan, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282006
pois.description: Funerary monument of Afzal Khan Shirazi, scholar and prime minister of Shah Jahan, featuring rare glazed Persian ceramic tile-work (chini).
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Unique surviving example of Persian glazed tile architecture in northern India
✓ Free entry
pois.tip: Observe the brilliant turquoise, cobalt, and gold tiles preserved on the eastern river-facing facade.

pois.name: Dayalbagh Memorial & Cultural Complex
pois.description: Magnificent continuous-construction pure white marble memorial combining temple, mosque, and church motifs with exquisite hand-carved floral bas-reliefs.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Astounding modern marble artisan craftsmanship
✓ Quiet spiritual atmosphere
✓ 4.5★ reviews
pois.tip: Photography is strictly prohibited inside the inner sanctuary; cameras and mobile phones must be placed in visitor lockers.

pois.name: Deviram Sweets & Confectioners
pois.address: Pratap Pura, Near MG Road, Agra Cantt, Agra 282001
pois.description: Historic morning culinary institution of Agra, revered across generations for authentic crispy Bedai with spicy potato fenugreek curry and hot golden jalebis.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Quintessential Agra heritage breakfast experience
✓ 100% vegetarian street food institution
✓ 4.6★ reviews
pois.tip: Visit between 7:30 AM and 10:00 AM when the Bedai and Jalebis are fried piping hot directly in front of you.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Bedai & Aloo Sabzi with Hot Kesariya Jalebi
pois.signature_dish: Agra Bedai & Aloo Sabzi (Crispy spiced urad dal lentil-stuffed puffed fried puris with tangy potato curry, garnished with ginger and green chilies)
pois.dish_ingredients: Whole wheat flour, spiced urad dal stuffing, potatoes, tomatoes, fenugreek, coriander, saffron sugar syrup (100% pure vegetarian)

provenance.price_source: Breakfast Menu Average (₹150 INR per person)

pois.name: Peshawri at ITC Mughal
pois.address: ITC Mughal, Fatehabad Road, Tajganj, Agra 282001
pois.description: Legendary luxury fine dining venue recreating the authentic rugged clay-tandoor flavors of the North-West Frontier in an opulent Mughal setting.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Ultra luxury culinary pinnacle in Agra
✓ Iconic Dal Bukhara/Peshawari simmered for 18 hours
✓ 4.8★ reviews
pois.tip: Reserve in advance. Dining is traditionally enjoyed with hands using bibs to fully appreciate the tandoori textures.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Dal Peshawari & Paneer Khurchan with Pudina Paratha
pois.signature_dish: Dal Peshawari (Black lentils, whole tomatoes, ginger and garlic simmered overnight on slow charcoal embers with cultured butter)
pois.dish_ingredients: Black lentils (urad), fresh cream, hand-churned butter, vine-ripened tomatoes, ginger, aromatic spices (Vegetarian preparation)

provenance.price_source: A la carte Set Dinner Average (₹2,500 INR per person)

pois.name: Dasaprakash Pure Vegetarian Restaurant
pois.address: Meher Cinema Complex, Gwalior Road, Agra Cantt, Agra 282001
pois.description: Long-established pure vegetarian haven serving authentic South Indian filter coffee, ghee roast dosas, and royal multi-course thalis.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ 100% Pure Vegetarian family-friendly establishment
✓ Crisp ghee dosas and traditional coconut chutney
✓ 4.5★ reviews
pois.tip: Pair the Special South Indian Thali with their signature freshly brewed Kumbakonam degree filter coffee.
pois.vegetarian_dish: Special South Indian Ghee Roast Thali
pois.signature_dish: Special South Indian Thali (Ghee roast masala dosa, sambar, rasam, curd rice, avial, kootu, poori, and payasam)
pois.dish_ingredients: Rice, lentils, fresh coconut, clarified butter (ghee), curry leaves, seasonal vegetables, jaggery (100% pure vegetarian)

provenance.price_source: Thali Lunch Average (₹450 INR per person)

pois.name: Panchhi Petha Authentic Store
pois.address: Near Sadar Bazaar Fountain, Agra Cantt, Agra 282001
pois.description: Original heritage sweet maker of Agra's world-famous ash gourd confectionery (petha), crafting over 25 varieties including saffron, paan, and chocolate.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Agra's most iconic historical sweet specialty
✓ Saffron-infused Kesar Angoori Petha tasting
pois.tip: Try the Kesar Angoori and Paan Petha for traditional rich flavors; vacuum packs are available for travel souvenirs.
pois.signature_dish: Kesar Angoori Petha (Translucent crystallized ash gourd balls steeped in pure Kashmiri saffron, cardamom, and rose water)
pois.dish_ingredients: Ash gourd (winter melon), sugar, Kashmiri saffron, cardamom, rose water, silver foil (100% pure vegetarian)

provenance.price_source: Confectionery Tasting Average (₹200 INR per box)

pois.name: Pinch of Spice Fine Dining
pois.address: 1076/2, Fatehabad Road, Tajganj, Agra, Uttar Pradesh 282001
pois.description: Highly acclaimed contemporary Indian restaurant on Fatehabad Road known for rich Awadhi gravies, clay-oven tandoori platters, and impeccable service.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Popular refined dinner venue with excellent North Indian vegetarian delicacies
✓ 4.6★ reviews
pois.tip: Order the Paneer Lababdar accompanied by garlic butter naan and saffron pulao.
pois.signature_dish: Paneer Lababdar (Fresh cottage cheese cubes in rich tomato, cashew, and melon seed gravy with grated paneer and kasuri methi)
pois.dish_ingredients: Fresh paneer, ripe tomatoes, cashew paste, ginger, kasuri methi, butter, cream, whole spices (Vegetarian)

provenance.price_source: A la carte Dinner Average (₹850 INR per person)

pois.name: Shankara Vegis Rooftop Restaurant
pois.address: Chowk Kagziyan, South Gate of Taj Mahal, Tajganj, Agra 282001
pois.description: Welcoming traveler-favorite rooftop cafe steps away from the South Gate of Taj Mahal, serving fresh homestyle pure vegetarian thalis and chai.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Peaceful rooftop terrace viewing old Tajganj neighborhood
✓ Wholesome home-style vegetarian cooking
pois.tip: Enjoy an afternoon ginger lemon honey tea with hot vegetable pakoras while relaxing between sightseeing stops.
pois.signature_dish: Special Veg Thali (Baingan Bharta, yellow dal tadka, jeera aloo, curd, freshly puffed phulkas, and basmati rice)
pois.dish_ingredients: Roasted eggplant, lentils, cumin potatoes, yogurt, whole wheat rotis, fresh coriander (100% pure vegetarian)

provenance.price_source: Casual Lunch Average (₹350 INR per person)
